items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: telling us Tom Lousey, they said, you have a putt-putt place to cross the same.

ctx.x: I'm making around nearly two hundred after you had extras. If there was any extra money I got it. If one of the places they blew his blues, he said, let Johnny play a chorus, it'll help my organ solo. You know what I mean? The organ used to go up. You know how to do it. And I'd come out of the alcove and put the derby and go in the St. Louis booth. I used to get all the extras. We used to do a radio program for a half hour. I used to get that. Ray McNamara, just Ray McNamara. He played the piano and I played the…
Did Ray McNamara ever write any tunes?
